mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as 20d return predictor is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC for UNRATE as 5d predictor is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for HOUST*RSAFS interaction term as 60d predictor is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS >4.5%) increase borrowing costs and reduce liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as corporate financing conditions deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS >4.5%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as 20d predictor in tightening cycles is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month industrial production decline below 110.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO as 5d predictor is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% for two months indicates labor market weakness that depresses consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE >5.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE as 60d predictor is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC for RSAFS as 20d return predictor is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO <110.0) increases input costs and reduces output capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as corporate margins compress.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO <110.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO as 5d predictor in contraction regimes is <0.03 over any 3-year window.
